function ProjectJourney() { const [city, setCity] = useState(""); const [status, setStatus] = useState(""); const [search, setSearch] = useState(""); const [form, setForm] = useState({ name: "", phone: "", email: "", requirement: "", message: "", }); const [submitted, setSubmitted] = useState(false); const filteredProjects = useMemo(() => { return projects.filter((project) => { const cityMatch = !city || project.location.toLowerCase().includes(city.toLowerCase()); const statusMatch = !status || project.status.toLowerCase().includes(status.toLowerCase()) || project.type.toLowerCase().includes(status.toLowerCase()); const searchMatch = !search || project.title.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase()) || project.location.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase()) || project.type.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase()); return cityMatch && statusMatch && searchMatch; }); }, [city, status, search]); const handleFormChange = (e) => { setForm({ ...form, [e.target.name]: e.target.value, }); }; const handleSubmit = (e) => { e.preventDefault(); if (!form.name || !form.phone) { alert("Please enter your name and phone number."); return; } const oldData = JSON.parse( localStorage.getItem("rehouse_project_enquiries") || "[]" ); const enquiry = { ...form, createdAt: new Date().toISOString(), source: "REHOUSE REALTORS Project Page", }; localStorage.setItem( "rehouse_project_enquiries", JSON.stringify([...oldData, enquiry]) ); window.dispatchEvent( new CustomEvent("rehouse-project-enquiry", { detail: form, }) ); setSubmitted(true); setForm({ name: "", phone: "", email: "", requirement: "", message: "", });
